'''Teepo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Lord]] and a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who lived during the [[New Sith Wars]], fighting alongside Lord [[Hoth (Jedi Lord)|Hoth]] as part of the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]].

==Biography==
===Jedi Lord===
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Teepo was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. As the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[New Sith Wars|warred]] with the [[New Sith]] Empire, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council's]] protégé [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Skere Kaan]] split from the Order and created the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] to serve as the new body of the Sith Empire. A [[Jedi Lord]], Teepo had a host of loyal [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] known as [[Teepo Paladins|Paladins]] as he ruled over his constituent worlds, protecting them from the Sith for years.<ref name="EGTW" /> Unlike the main body of the Order on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Teepo and his followers believed that [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] should be utilized in conjunction with the Order's traditional weapon, the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The Paladins focused strongly on their connection to the Force, wearing masks to enhance their connection to the mystic energy field.<ref name="CNI" />

When Lord [[Hoth (Jedi Lord)|Hoth]] rallied the banners of the Lords across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Teepo and his Paladins answered the call to war and joined Hoth's [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] as they swept across the galaxy and crushed several Sith strongholds.<ref name="EGTW" /> Following the conclusion of the war in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and the passage of the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]] by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] censured Teepo and his followers for their use of blasters and their involvement in the war. Retreating from Coruscant, Teepo and his surviving Paladins survived without the Order, practicing their beliefs in peace far from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="CNI" />

===Legacy===
Over the ensuing millennia, long after Teepo's death, the Paladins thrived as a separate group within the Order. Keeping their distance from Coruscant and the High Council, an offshoot group known as the [[Gray Paladin]]s formed from breakaway members of the Teepos, practicing more radical beliefs then their Teepo cousins.<ref name="CNI" /> Ironically, Teepo's Paladins survived the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] that ravaged the Jedi Order in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], remaining active well into the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGTW" />
